units: All strain/tilt values are mm/m (millistrain-equivalent slope/strain). PPV is mm/s. Pore pressure is kPa. Battery is V. Time windows are hours or days as named per field.

tilt_change.label: Tilt change since install
tilt_change.basis: 3 and 10 mm/m carried from sandbox/constants.py TILT_WARNING_MM_M/TILT_CRITICAL_MM_M (ASSUMED); advisory 1.5 ASSUMED
tilt_change.description: How far this node's tilt has moved from its day-0 install reading, in millimetres of tilt per metre of baseline; sustained tilt is the earliest sign a node sits over a moving subsidence trough.

strain_tensile.label: Tensile strain
strain_tensile.basis: 5.3 mm/m Kamptee coalfield limit carried from constants.py EPS_TENSILE_LIMIT (VERIFY: no DGMS circular cited)
strain_tensile.description: The greatest stretching (tensile) ground strain measured at this node, in millimetres of stretch per metre; high tensile strain is what opens cracks and pulls foundations apart.

strain_compressive.label: Compressive strain
strain_compressive.description: The greatest squeezing (compressive) ground strain measured at this node, in millimetres of compression per metre (magnitude, sign discarded); high compressive strain buckles slabs and heaves floors.

tilt_rate.label: Tilt rate (24 h)
tilt_rate.basis: ASSUMED early-warning threshold; no cited source. No CRITICAL rung — a fast rate is a leading indicator, the absolute tilt_change limits carry the CRITICAL call.
tilt_rate.description: How fast this node's tilt is changing right now, in millimetres per metre per day over the last 24 hours; a fast rate flags active ground movement even before the total tilt is large.

crack_width.label: Crack width
crack_width.basis: Burland, Broms & de Mello (1977) / BRE Digest 251 damage categories by crack width: 0 negligible <0.1, 1 very slight <1, 2 slight 1-5, 3 moderate 5-15, 4 severe 15-25, 5 very severe >25 mm
crack_width.description: The width of the widest crack tracked at this node, in millimetres, classified against the Burland/BRE Digest 251 building-damage categories.

categories.name: very slight
categories.description: Fine cracks, easily treated during normal decoration.

categories.name: slight
categories.description: Cracks easily filled; some external repointing may be needed for weather-tightness.

categories.name: moderate
categories.description: Cracks need some opening-up and can be patched by a mason; possible slight jamming of doors and windows.

categories.name: severe
categories.description: Extensive repair involving breaking-out and replacing sections of wall; door and window frames distorted, floors sloping.

categories.name: very severe
categories.description: Structural damage requiring major repair, including partial or complete rebuilding.

ppv.label: Peak particle velocity
ppv.basis: DGMS (Tech) Circular 7 of 1997, domestic structures (VERIFY every number against the circular)
ppv.description: Peak particle velocity from blasting or ground shock, in millimetres per second, judged against the frequency-dependent DGMS domestic-structure limit for the dominant vibration frequency.

pore_pressure_rise.label: Pore pressure rise over 7-day baseline
pore_pressure_rise.description: The rise in pore water pressure at this node above its trailing 7-day baseline, in kilopascals; a rising pore pressure can precede slope or floor failure.

battery_low.label: Battery low
battery_low.description: The node's battery voltage; a low reading means the node may go offline before it is serviced.

comms_stale.label: Comms stale
comms_stale.description: No data packet has arrived from this node for several expected reporting intervals; the node may be offline, jammed, or out of range.

sensor_flatline.label: Sensor flatline
sensor_flatline.description: A sensor channel has reported the exact same value for hours on end, which usually means the sensor is stuck rather than the ground being perfectly still.
